instruction: Candid photographic medium shot of an indoor dance studio with a dark background. On the left, the woman in the mustard-yellow shirt (R2) stands with her left arm arched overhead, looking forward with a serious expression. In the center, the man in the rust-brown shirt (R3) is in profile facing left, his right arm arched over his head as he looks down. They stand close together, their raised arms overlapping in a dense group composition. On the right, a bystander woman with curly reddish-blonde hair in a mustard-yellow shirt looks upward with raised arms, surrounded by other blurred hands in the background. Dim, dramatic overhead lighting illuminates the scene with a warm color palette.

R2 and R3 stand close together with their raised arms overlapping
